prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick Cheat Sheet Screen: Adds a dedicated controls quick sheet screen ('new_controls_cheatsheet') right after home_intro explaining how to drag, right-click, hide, and speak to the desktop pet. (why: Support mail highlighted 3 issues where users were confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Path Grid Layout Redesign: Redesigns the choose_path screen into a two-column grid layout to present pre-made and custom pet creation options clearly side-by-side. (why: choose_path screen has a median of 8s but a huge mean of 514s, indicating severe long-tail confusion when choosing a pet creation path.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Engine Prep Stage Screen: Inserts a 'new_engine_prep' checklist screen before waiting screen to detail desktop overlay initialization steps. (why: Support mail reported pet desktop display stalls/failures (3 emails) and home waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Data Retention Notice: Displays a explicit cloud backup hint banner on the sign_in screen guaranteeing pet safety across logins. (why: Support mail's top issue (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Stage Grid View: Changes pick_friend screen layout to stage view showing large character badges. (why: Adoption stage experiences substantial user drop-off with 71.9% completion rate and median 89s duration.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Load Progress Info: Enables progress bar and estimated wait time display on waiting screen during desktop rendering. (why: Home waiting stage takes a long median time of 201s, causing users to abandon before completion.)
6: [finish, incentive] First Interaction Desktop Reward Banner: Adds a festive mascot component and playful text on home_intro celebrating successful onboarding completion. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8%, bringing overall onboarding completion down to 28.2%.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Clear Onboarding Duration Copy: Updates story screen body copy to emphasize quick 2-minute setup time. (why: Choose path stage exhibits high hesitation with a 514s mean duration.)
8: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Requirements Diagnostic Callout: Adds a detailed quality checklist hint on upload_photos screen specifying good lighting and clear angles. (why: Support mail noted 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
